root_cause: A round timestamp (20261027170000) was chosen for a migration while another session had already registered saas_trial_v1 under the same version in production, so the repository held a version that production attributed to a different migration.
fix: Rename to an unused version (20261027171500) and register production under it; content unchanged.
prevention_rule: Before choosing a migration version, read the latest versions from schema_migrations and use a version no other session has registered.
terminal_rule: Merged main with a unique migration version that equals the production schema_migrations entry.
